profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Zocdoc
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Interested in distributed systems, hard problems, open source, helping humankind.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Improving developer productivity and operation excellence across the organization though our Platform teams. Dev-Ex, Infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, core libraries and shared services.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Improving conversion using machine learning for search (Learning to Rank) using LightGBM, pyspark and Elastic Search. Responsibilities include: data logging + production pipelines, modeling, production service implementation and deployment.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped lead the initiative to migrate our existing application to AWS and experiment with new technologies. Successfully brought these prototypes to production quality and drove adoption throughout the organization; increasing developer productivity.

positions.title: Recurser
positions.description: Deep dive into Database internals with the CMU courses, Red Book and other papers from the field. Implemented my own OLAP style vectorized columnar query engine from scratch; sql parsing, query planning, logical and physical plan optimization and query execution using TPC-H as the benchmark. https://github.com/ChrisSmith/database

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer on the Weatherwise Android app, a highly animated and interactive weather app in the burgeoning days of Android development.

Also worked on the development of a unity game and social website.
